verdict.rationale: Wise Platform docs explicitly describe how businesses without financial licenses can offer accounts to their customers (wise-docs-5), backed by concrete APIs for creating multi-currency accounts (wise-docs-1, wise-docs-25), letting customers claim ownership of accounts created on their behalf (wise-docs-18), issuing cards (wise-docs-14), and embedding hosted flows via iframe/webview (wise-docs-26), plus passthrough FDIC insurance (wise-docs-11) to reassure end customers. This directly matches the embedded-banking-without-a-license story as a first-party documented capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that a developer has successfully built and shipped such an embedded offering, and community evidence shows some friction (account detail changes, profile-category blocking) that could affect reliability of accounts issued to end customers.
